text:
Lucas: Hi! I'm joining from Barcelona next Monday. Two quick things: 1) When do EU hires get health/benefits active? 2) I need to change my direct deposit to a local IBAN before payday  who do I send that to? Also I have a small relocation reimbursement in EUR  any special instructions for foreign currency receipts?

Maya (People Ops): Welcome, Lucas! :wave: EU hires follow the same 30-day enrollment window but local statutory benefits timing can vary. For our private plan supplement, enrollment opens within 3 business days and carrier effective date is typically 1st of month after 30 days.

Derek (Benefits): For Barcelona specifically: statutory health is via local registration (you'll get guidance), and our supplemental/private coverage kicks per Maya's note. Upload passport/registration to benefits portal for dependent verification if needed.

Lucas: OK. For payroll IBAN change  urgent before first paycheck. Is there a secure place to submit?

Oksana (Payroll EU): Please use the payroll portal "Banking" tab and add your IBAN. If you need to change before cutoff, send a secure upload to payroll-eu@redwood.example with subject: "BANK CHANGE - Lucas - <offerID>" and we'll prioritize. Cutoff for next run is 48h before payday.

Lucas: Cool. Relocation receipts are in EUR and one receipt is a credit card statement without merchant name (hotel charged by aggregator). Will that be OK?

Maya (People Ops): We prefer original receipts with vendor and amount. If card statement lacks vendor, include booking confirmation or a hotel folio PDF. Tag currency as EUR when you submit in Expensely. Finance will convert using the company FX rate on the reimbursement date.

Oksana (Payroll EU): Note: reimbursements in EUR will be paid in EUR if we have an EU bank on file, otherwise we convert to USD and pay in payroll. Put "EUR reimbursement" in the expense note if you'd like EUR payout.

Lucas: Great. One more: public holidays and PTO  do Spanish national holidays count as company holidays for remote EU hires?

Maya (People Ops): We observe US company holidays globally as paid days off by default. Local public holidays are not automatically observed, but you can use PTO to cover them. Some teams allow regional holiday swaps  ask your manager and we can record exceptions.

Onboard Bot: Checklist update: benefits enrollment link emailed; payroll banking incomplete. Link: https://onboard.redwood.example/lu-1773

Derek (Benefits): Reminder: if you want to enroll in our voluntary dental/vision, do it in the portal within 30 days. For HSA  not applicable outside US. For EU benefits questions ping me and I'll route to local carrier rep.

Lucas: Thanks all, super helpful. I'll upload the IBAN tonight and attach the hotel folio. Also will ask my manager about a regional holiday swap. :+1:
